title: Curious Urgency 64
author: bpatrick
body: Coming up: New es&d, fun pack 4, maybe another es&d. No summer of comics this year; it’s been supplanted by summer of board exams. Fun packs are not where I wanted them to be so I’m extending fun club memberships beyond six ’til I get it right.

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text: No worries on the fun packs– i can only speak for myself of course, but it was worth all the money just for that first thing you sent.

comments.author: D
comments.text: Good luck for your summer of board exams then. Doesn’t sound appealing. Fun packs or not, I love akimbocomics very much.

comments.author: Pieter
comments.text: Good luck on the boards exams – and I easily owe you $50 for the good times so thanks for extending the fun packs.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: I’m going to keep checking the site regularly; the Summer of Board Exams may just be the cauldron of frustration, stress, and nerves to cook up some really good comic ideas. Best of luck b.
